sources.citation: A. Haro, A. Luque, *A-posteriori KAM theory with optimal estimates for partially integrable systems*, J. Differential Equations (2019)
sources.role: Primary for the fixed-frequency a-posteriori theorem: Thm 3.1 (§3.2) with d = n, explicit constants in App. B

sources.citation: R. de la Llave, A. González, À. Jorba, J. Villanueva, *KAM theory without action-angle variables*, Nonlinearity 18 (2005) 855–895

sources.citation: J. Pöschel, *A lecture on the classical KAM theorem*, Proc. Symp. Pure Math. 69 (2001) 707–732
sources.role: Measure layer (Thm A, App. B) and measure of Diophantine vectors (§1); pinned arXiv text is Version 1.3 (2009)

sources.citation: J.-Ll. Figueras, A. Haro, A. Luque, *Rigorous computer assisted application of KAM theory: a modern approach*, Found. Comput. Math. 17 (2017)
sources.role: Explicit a-posteriori constants (Thm 2.5, maps); measure of Diophantine vectors (§4.1); Rüssmann estimates (§4.2)

sources.citation: L. Chierchia, C. E. Koudjinan, *V. I. Arnold's "global" KAM theorem and geometric measure estimates*, Regul. Chaotic Dyn. 26 (2021)

D. A. Salamon, *The Kolmogorov–Arnold–Moser theorem*, Math. Phys. Electron. J. 10 (2004), Paper 3
